basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old hobbyist from Portland, Oregon, with a passion for all things remote control and DIY. I work as a mechanical engineer by day, which feeds my obsession with understanding how things work. When I'm not tinkering with my RC vehicles, you'll find me in my workshop crafting custom knives or working on my Snapmaker projects. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings, especially after a long day at work. I'm single, which gives me plenty of time to dive into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in RC vehicles comes from years of hands-on experience and my engineering background. I've been tuning, repairing, and racing RC cars since high school. My technical skills are further honed by my profession, which involves a lot of problem-solving and mechanical design. I'm largely self-taught in knifemaking and have learned a lot from online communities and trial and error.
